items.prompt:
Homologous structures are similar body parts that come from:
A) Different ancestors
B) A common ancestor
C) No ancestor
D) The environment only

steps: Homologous structures are inherited from a common ancestor.

items.prompt:
A human arm, whale flipper, and bat wing share the same basic:
A) Color
B) Bone pattern
C) Diet
D) Habitat

steps: They share the same underlying bone structure.

items.prompt:
If two organisms have very similar structures, they are usually:
A) Not related
B) Closely related
C) Nonliving
D) Extinct

steps: More similar structures indicate a closer relationship.

items.prompt:
Homologous structures can:
A) Only do identical jobs
B) Do different jobs while sharing the same basic structure
C) Never be inherited
D) Only be found in plants
items.answer: B) Do different jobs while sharing the same basic structure

steps: A bat wing and a human arm differ in job but share structure.

items.prompt:
Two animals have nearly identical skeletons; a third is very different. The two with identical skeletons are:
A) Not related
B) Probably more closely related
C) Definitely the same species
D) Nonliving

steps: Greater structural similarity suggests a closer relationship.

items.prompt:
Comparing a modern animal with its fossils can show:
A) Nothing useful
B) How its features changed over time
C) The weather long ago
D) Its future
items.answer: B) How its features changed over time

steps: Differences between fossils and modern forms reveal change over time.

items.prompt:
Why do homologous structures provide evidence of common ancestry?
A) They are exactly the same in every species
B) Shared underlying structure is best explained by inheritance from a shared ancestor
C) They appear randomly
D) They have no pattern
items.answer: B) Shared underlying structure is best explained by inheritance from a shared ancestor

steps: Inherited shared structure is evidence of a common ancestor.

items.prompt:
A fossil whale has small leg bones that modern whales lack. This best supports the idea that:
A) Whales never change
B) Whale features changed over time from leg-bearing ancestors
C) Whales are plants
D) Legs appeared recently
items.answer: B) Whale features changed over time from leg-bearing ancestors

steps: The transitional fossil shows features changed over time.
